title: Master Product Design (écal)
info: 커리어의 결정적 전환점이자 산업디자인 학사 과정의 후속으로, 디자이너 실천의 두 축인 개인 연구와 고객·기업·생산자의 의뢰를 전문적으로 다루는 일에 집중하는 석사 과정입니다. 학위는 Master of Arts HES-SO in Design, major in Product Design입니다. As a decisive turning point in a career or as a follow-up to a Bachelor in Industrial Design, this Master's program is for students wishing to focus on two fundamental aspects of a designer’s practice: personal research as well as the professional handling of commissions for clients, companies or producers. Master of Arts HES-SO in Design, major in Product Design.
